verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes a working llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and provides machine-readable .md versions of its docs (e.g., docs/bugbot.md), directly enabling an agent to be pointed at agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: no evidence of llms-full.txt or explicit guidance encouraging agents to consume these docs, and no independent report of an agent successfully using this format end-to-end.
